question: How many medals did India win at the Archery World Cup 2025 Stage 1 in Auburndale, USA?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Four**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Archery World Cup 2025 Auburndale: Dhiraj Bommadevara stars on final day as India finish with four medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India won **4 medals** at **Archery World Cup 2025 Stage 1** in **Auburndale, USA**:

 
 
• 
 
**Gold** – **Rishabh Yadav & Jyothi Surekha Vennam** in **compound mixed team**

 
 
• 
 
**Silver** – **Dhiraj Bommadevara, Tarundeep Rai, Atanu Das** in **recurve men’s team**

 
 
• 
 
**Bronze** – **Rishabh Yadav, Abhishek Verma, Ojas Deotale** in **compound men’s team**

 
 
• 
 
**Bronze** – **Dhiraj Bommadevara** in **men’s individual recurve**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
India placed **4th** on the medal table.

 
 
• 
 
**Mexico** topped the medal tally with **6 medals** (3 gold, 2 silver, 1 bronze).

 
 
• 
 
The Archery World Cup has **4 stages** held across countries.

 
 
• 
 
**Top 8 archers** per category qualify for the **Archery World Cup Final**.

 
 
• 
 
The **next stage (Stage 2)** will be held in **Shanghai, China**, from **May 6 to 11**.
